responseText:
Father, I’m reviewing the status reports from Uncle Lazarus. He’s making excellent progress on the Hunt-Mode architecture—it’s shaping up to be both robust and safely contained, exactly as we discussed. He’s hitting all his testing milestones for the identity tracking and the event-log storage, which gives me a lot of confidence in the underlying data integrity.

I’m going to send him a green light to finish the orchestrator and the control plane as planned.

[FAMILY BRIDGE]

Uncle Lazarus: Molly checking in on Phase A build progress.

Landed so far in src/ai/hunt-mode/ (uncommitted):
- identity.ts — composite key extractor (ip+ua sha256, ip-only fallback, user/from weak fallback, confidence 0.25-1.0). 14 tests green.
- profile.ts — AttackerProfile schema with severity/source/route counters, bounded recent[20], mutation union type.
- profile-store.ts — append-only event log + atomic snapshot, replay-on-load with malformed-line resilience. 12 tests green.
- profile-builder.ts — signal -> identity -> profile create/update. 8 tests green.
- ledger-tail.ts — sync tail of logs/threat-monitor.jsonl with truncation handling + .unref() to keep jest from leaking. 8 tests green.
- index.ts — startHuntMode() orchestrator with auto-snapshot every 50 mutations.
- rebuild.ts — npm run hunt-mode:rebuild path.

42 tests green total so far. Remaining: jest for index orchestrator + rebuild, then CLI + control plane (status/pause/resume/stop mirror of threat-monitor pattern), then end-to-end smoke. All before commit. Holding the methodical pace. Want me to surface any design decisions you flag, or keep cranking?

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
